# Pull Request / 拉取请求

## Summary / 变更说明

<!-- What changed and why? / 修改了什么，为什么需要修改？ -->

## Related Issue / 关联 Issue

<!-- Use "Closes #123" when appropriate. / 如适用，请使用 "Closes #123"。 -->

## Verification / 验证

<!-- List exact commands and results. / 请列出准确的验证命令与结果。 -->
<!-- Examples / 示例：pnpm exec vitest run <test-file>; pnpm run preflight -->

## Checklist / 检查清单

- [ ] The change is focused and excludes unrelated edits. / 变更范围聚焦，不包含无关修改。
- [ ] Behavior changes include focused tests, or I explained why tests are unnecessary. / 行为变化已补充定向测试，或已说明无需测试的原因。
- [ ] User-facing behavior and capability boundaries are documented when relevant. / 如涉及用户可见行为或能力边界，文档已同步更新。
- [ ] I did not edit generated `dist/` files or include secrets, personal memory, or private paths. / 未修改生成的 `dist/` 文件，且不包含凭据、个人记忆或私有路径。

<!-- For template, adapter, or lifecycle changes, also review Host-neutrality, path safety, rollback, concurrency, permissions, and user-owned files. -->
<!-- 对 template、Adapter 或生命周期变更，还需检查宿主中立、路径安全、回滚、并发、权限和用户文件保护。 -->

## Additional Notes / 补充说明

<!-- Optional: migration, compatibility, recovery, or follow-up notes. / 可选：迁移、兼容、恢复或后续说明。 -->
